verdicts.note: Row of adobe mill cells with wooden lattice sail frames and plank doors on the walled terrace.
Interior of a mud-brick mill chamber; a man crouches beside the wooden drive shaft and gear of the mill.

Wide view along the mill row: adobe windmill cells, sail lattices, stairs and people on the terrace.
Adobe compound walls and courtyard of the mill complex with a doorway; a visitor walks inside.

Vaulted mud-brick interior passage of the mill complex with an arched opening and plank door.
